rejected: Speckled eye, nose and lip patches on interpenetrating facial surfaces. The first cleanup also removed the eyebrow relief; outer shell and eyelids were refitted.
First remount revision showed detached dark spikes in the mane and a conspicuous pale grey coat. The second was checked on the same trotting rider from six viewpoints.
Two original dyes were too orange next to the archers' sunlit faces. The third trial uses a deeper sewn madder shoulder and keeps the shadowed crossed collar.
open: The ordinary 22 m view still relies on uniform, equipment and facing for recognition.
Repetition and accidental projected intersections remain in closed ranks.
User has not accepted in-game artistic quality.
The gate, grass and uniform silhouette need another substantial in-game visual pass after comparison with the owner's approved wider concept.

linux.renderer: Ubuntu 24.04, Godot 4.6.3, llvmpipe, software OpenGL. Four sizes, 1280x800, native resolution, 4x MSAA, shadows. Short 20 rendered frames per size; movie fixed-time data are not used for performance.

acceptance.game_engine: Original CI had five passing jobs, one field capture timed out at its six-minute limit after all four size samples passed, and review-footage was skipped because of the matrix job dependency. Corrected recording ran all 360 frames with unchanged inputs and an identical game resource tree. Actual normal-speed Linux export and nine native Mac launches each passed in the original run.

recording_recovery.preserve_previews: Original full and small journey clips and checksums were produced by the original Verify field journey job.
